# ==================================================================
# serenitybali.com - robots.txt
#
# WHERE THIS GOES
#   Wix dashboard > Marketing & SEO > SEO Tools > Robots.txt Editor
#   Replace the whole file with everything below, then Save.
#
# WHAT WAS KEPT
#   Every rule Wix generates for this site was read from the live
#   file on 22 Sep 2026 and is preserved below unchanged: the
#   lightbox disallow, the AdsBot group, the PetalBot block and the
#   two crawl-delays. Pasting a hand-written robots.txt over the
#   generated one is the usual way those quietly disappear.
#
# WHAT WAS ADDED
#   1. An explicit group for the AI assistants that send referral
#      traffic. They are allowed, deliberately: a guesthouse gains
#      from being quotable when someone asks an assistant where to
#      stay in Canggu. Remove a line here to opt that one out.
#   2. A group for the AI crawlers that only harvest training data
#      and send nothing back. Blocked.
#   3. A disallow for the two duplicate and scratch pages found in
#      the sitemap, so they stop competing with the real ones.
#
# ONE RULE THAT MATTERS MORE THAN IT LOOKS (RFC 9309 s2.2)
#   A line placed before the first "User-agent:" belongs to no group
#   and every compliant crawler discards it. Nothing below floats
#   above a group header for that reason. Groups with the same agent
#   name are merged by the crawler (s2.2.1), so the layout here is
#   safe but should not be rearranged casually.
#
# WHAT ROBOTS.TXT CANNOT DO
#   It does not remove a page from Google. A disallowed URL can still
#   be indexed from links elsewhere, just without its content. To get
#   a page out of the index, mark it noindex in Wix's SEO panel and
#   leave it crawlable so the tag can be seen.
# ==================================================================

User-agent: *
Allow: /
Disallow: *?lightbox=
Disallow: /copy-of-home-1
Disallow: /blank

# Optimization for Google Ads Bot
User-agent: AdsBot-Google-Mobile
User-agent: AdsBot-Google
Disallow: /_partials*
Disallow: /pro-gallery-webapp/v1/galleries/*

# Block PetalBot
User-agent: PetalBot
Disallow: /

# Crawl delay for overly enthusiastic bots
User-agent: dotbot
Crawl-delay: 10
User-agent: AhrefsBot
Crawl-delay: 10

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# AI assistants that cite sources and send readers back. Allowed.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
User-agent: OAI-SearchBot
User-agent: ChatGPT-User
User-agent: PerplexityBot
User-agent: Perplexity-User
User-agent: Claude-User
User-agent: Claude-SearchBot
User-agent: Google-Extended
Allow: /
Disallow: *?lightbox=

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Training-data crawlers with no referral path back. Blocked.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
User-agent: GPTBot
User-agent: ClaudeBot
User-agent: CCBot
User-agent: Bytespider
User-agent: Amazonbot
User-agent: Applebot-Extended
User-agent: meta-externalagent
User-agent: Diffbot
User-agent: Omgilibot
User-agent: ImagesiftBot
Disallow: /

Sitemap: https://www.serenitybali.com/sitemap.xml
